style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body and weapon always inside the frame with a margin, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth and tails always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: A
segments.prompt: A chibi nine-tailed fox empress in white and gold armour with very long red hair and nine big fluffy fox tails, wielding a long-hafted crescent moon glaive. From her guard stance she lowers the glaive to trail behind her at hip height and accelerates into an in-place run facing screen-right, leaning her whole body forward: her pelvis stays horizontally anchored in place, her legs start alternating with clear foot contacts, her free arm swings. The motion keeps flowing into the last frame without slowing down or holding a pose, ending exactly in the pose of the last frame mid-stride. Locked stationary camera, no horizontal drift, pan, zoom or turn. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the glaive, kept rigid and moving with her hands. Her hair, cape and the nine tails stream back behind her: the tail roots stay fixed at her lower back in the same order, the fan of tails never rotates or spins as a whole, each tail bends and trails with natural delay. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid glaive, always drawn whole. No added flames, aura or particles.
